get_account.description: Get an Algorand account's ALGO balance, minimum balance and what it can spend, whether it is online in consensus, its rewards, whether it is rekeyed, and how many assets and applications it holds and created.

receiver.description: Who received the ALGO or asset, or for an asset freeze the address frozen. Empty for other types.

summary.description: One line saying what it did, e.g. 'Transfer of 6.39 USDC from ... to ...'.

description: Read the Algorand blockchain through Nodely's free public service: account balances, assets held and transactions, transaction lookup and search by type, asset, note, time and amount, blocks and network status with fees, Algorand Standard Assets (ASAs) with their holders and transfers, and applications (smart contracts) with their state and logs, on MainNet or TestNet. A trigger runs on each new transaction to or from an address. No account or API key required.

algorand_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for each new transaction an Algorand address sends or receives: payments, asset transfers, application calls and more, with the amount, note and a one-line summary. Transactions from before the workflow is turned on never run it.
